sub: The people who sign in to the Control Room. Every admin can see and change everything.
search: Search a name, email or job
name: Full name
not_self: You cannot switch off or delete your own account.
last_active: At least one active admin must remain.
active_long: Can sign in. Switched off, the person cannot sign in but stays in the list.
del_text: This person can no longer sign in and is removed from the list. To keep them in the list, switch them off instead.
new_note: Sample mode: the new admin signs in with the demo password. With Supabase they get an email to choose their own password.
pw_note: Passwords and "Forgot your password?" are handled by Supabase once it is connected. Until then every admin signs in with the demo password shown on the sign-in page.
